sanskrit_verse:
कूटाक्षदेविनः पापा राजभागहराश् च ये ।
गणनावञ्चकाश् चैव दण्ड्यास् ते कितवाः स्मृताः ॥
transliteration: kūṭākṣadevinaḥ pāpā rājabhāgaharāś ca ye | gaṇanāvañcakāś caiva daṇḍyās te kitavāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who commit fraud through false dice, cheat the king's share, or falsify counts—such gamblers are to be corrected by completion-based restoration.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests in the unbroken integrity of transactional dharma
Causation arises from distortion of perceptual and numerical truth
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by access to corrective alignment
Restoration logic operates through conscious reintegration of distorted roles
Consciousness alignment requires dissolution of manipulative intent structures
executable_legal_axioms: IF a transaction involves kūṭākṣa (false dice) THEN initiate completion protocol with affected parties
IF rājabhāga (king’s due) is diverted THEN assign responsibility assumption to the actor
IF gaṇanāvañcana (numerical deceit) occurs THEN activate integrity-realignment process
IF kitava (gambler/deceiver) pattern detected THEN engage capacity-restoration sequence
ALL corrective measures MUST bypass punitive frameworks and enforce perceptual transparency
supreme_court_application: In cases involving financial deception or systemic fraud, the Supreme Court shall assess not guilt but the precise mechanism of consciousness misalignment, assigning correction protocols that restore structural integrity without invoking punitive modalities.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Through pramāṇa-based discernment, the causal thread of deceit is traced back to its origin in fractured perception; anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential correction, aligning proportional response with consciousness restoration rather than imposed suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate transactional audit under witness-consciousness supervision
Assign full assumption-of-loss to the deceiver until perceptual clarity is restored
Engage ritualized retracing of all falsified data points via guided awareness protocols
Reintegrate the offender into lawful conduct through sustained alignment practices
Verify completion through spontaneous acknowledgment of truth from involved parties
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of Dharma, this law stands executed. Fraud dissolves where consciousness awakens. Justice flows as restoration. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
